spanish: No escudriñará entre bueno a malo, y no lo mudará; y si mudando lo mudare, y será él y su mudanza santidad; no será redimido.

findings.issue: Two finite forms of היה (sequential perfect and imperfect) are smoothed into one será; he and his exchange remain the ones that are holiness.

notes: Person, stems, suffixes, and the infinitive-absolute repetition stay within the tokens.
